proof:
by
  have key : ∀ (l : List α) (n : ℕ), n ≤ l.length → (l.insertIdx n elt).Perm (elt :: l) := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil =>
      intro n hn
      have hn0 : n = 0 := by
        simp only [List.length_nil] at hn
        omega
      subst hn0
      simp only [List.insertIdx]
      exact List.Perm.refl _
    | cons hd tl IH =>
      intro n hn
      cases n with
      | zero =>
        simp only [List.insertIdx]
        exact List.Perm.refl _
      | succ n' =>
        have hn' : n' ≤ tl.length := by
          have h2 := hn
          simp only [List.length_cons] at h2
          omega
        have step : (hd :: tl.insertIdx n' elt).Perm (hd :: elt :: tl) := (IH n' hn').cons hd
        have combined := step.trans (List.Perm.swap elt hd tl)
        simpa [List.insertIdx] using combined
  exact ((key l1 idx1 hidx1).trans (hPerm.cons elt)).trans ((key l2 idx2 hidx2).symm)
